description_en: Sets the blocked regions for Location Blacklist (domain-specific) of website services
description_zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁（针对域名）的封禁地区
name: ModifyWebAreaBlock

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to configure geo-blocking.

The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的域名。

域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The list of regions to block.

If you do not set this parameter, the Location Blacklist (domain-specific) feature is shutdown
parameters.help_zh:
要封禁的地域列表。

不设置该参数表示关闭区域封禁（针对域名）功能
parameters.name: regions
